blocks.text: Kingdom Protista mein woh eukaryotes aate hain jo unicellular (ek cell wale), colonial (cells ki basti), filamentous (dhaage jaise) ya simple multicellular hote hain. Simple multicellular ka matlab hai ke in mein multicellular sex organs (kai cells se bane reproductive organs) nahi hote. Protists teen qisam ke hain.
Kuch protists parasites hain aur bimariyan paida karte hain: malaria (Plasmodium), amoebic dysentery yani pechish (Entamoeba histolytica) aur sleeping sickness (Trypanosoma).

items: Group Protozoa mein janwaron jaise (animal-like) protists aate hain. Yeh unicellular aur heterotrophic hain, yani apni ghiza khud nahi banate. Misaalein: Paramecium, Amoeba, Plasmodium aur Trypanosoma.

Group Algae mein podon jaise (plant-like) protists aate hain. Zyada tar algae ki cell walls hoti hain, aksar cellulose ki; in mein chlorophyll hota hai aur yeh autotrophs hain, yani photosynthesis se apni ghiza khud banate hain. Misaalein: Euglena aur diatoms.

Groups Myxomycota aur Oomycota mein fungi jaise (fungi-like) protists aate hain. In mein hyphae jaisi banawat hoti hai aur yeh saprophytic hain, yani mari hui cheezon se ghiza lete hain. Misaalein: slime molds aur water molds.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke algae ki cell walls cellulose ki hoti hain aur misal Euglena aur diatoms deti hai. In dono mein cellulose ki wall nahin: Euglena mein cell wall hi nahin hoti, us ki cell membrane ke neeche protein ki lachakdar teh, pellicle (jhilli jaisi teh), hoti hai; diatoms ki wall silica (sheeshe jaisa maadda) ki hai jo do hisson se bani hai. Baqi zyada tar algae ki cell walls aksar cellulose ki hoti hain.
